subject: Roadmap ownership, timeline rebaseline, and delivery risk rundown
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Roadmap ownership, timeline rebaseline, and delivery risk rundown

Team —

As we approach the QBR window I want to surface the current state of the product/eng roadmap and propose a focused rebaseline for the launches scheduled across H1. This thread consolidates what I reviewed with PM/ENG leads this morning and is intended to: (1) clarify ownership per milestone, (2) propose a constrained timeline to preserve our OKR delivery signal, and (3) call out risks requiring executive decisions.

Summary (short):
- Target set: shipping inference autoscaling + routing improvements (Launch A) and the dedicated capacity billing changes (Launch B) across Jan–Mar.
- Immediate ask: confirm owners and a realistic go/no-go boundary by Friday EOD (Dec 4).
- Big risks: KV cache regression risk under long sequences, billing contract edge-cases with marketplace partners, and a resource gap on the runtime performance team during Jan sprint 1.

Concrete items:
1) Ownership and checkpoints
   - Launch A (autoscaling/routing): Owner = Karthik Iyer — checkpoint cadence: weekly demo + perf heatmap by Dec 10.
   - Launch B (billing/marketplace): Owner = Laura Bennett — procurement signoff + integration test plan by Dec 8.
   - Cross-cutting infra work (latency SLOs, KV cache validation): Owner = Marcus Lin — run a 48h soak test by Dec 12.

2) Proposed rebaseline (minimal changes to preserve OKR):
   - Freeze feature additions for Launch A on Dec 15; target limited rollout (canary) Jan 20.
   - Launch B to push from Jan 10 -> Feb 1 to ensure marketplace contract changes and QA are complete.

3) Risk matrix and decision points (attached)
   - KV cache instability: high severity if unaddressed — mitigation: allocate 1 FTE from serving runtime team for two sprints (Jan 3–Jan 16).
   - Billing edge-cases: medium severity — mitigation: dedicated integration window + API contract tests with marketplace partner.
   - Resource gap: immediate escalation required if we cannot backfill.

Asks: please reply with: owner confirmation, any objections to the rebaseline, and whether you can commit to the checkpoints above. If we cannot get commitments by Friday EOD (Dec 4), I will escalate to execs for tradeoff decisions that may impact OKR scoring.

Attachments: delivery-risk-matrix.xlsx, commitment-rebaseline.md

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap ownership, timeline rebaseline, and delivery risk rundown

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 09:02 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> As we approach the QBR window I want to surface the current state ...
> 
Thanks, Mina — good, concise framing. A couple quick items from my side:

- Karthik, confirm ownership and whether your weekly demo can include a short perf comparison (baseline vs. optimized kernels). That will be critical for my exec briefing.
- Laura, procurement timeline is a hard dependency for Launch B — if procurement is not on track, we should consider a scoped rollback plan rather than shifting the entire launch window.
- On the KV cache issue: Marcus, can you quantify expected test coverage and whether the 48h soak is sufficient to catch the regressions we saw in Nov? If not, propose alternatives.

I want to avoid multiple schedule changes; use this rebaseline to create a defendable plan for QBR. Please escalate any blockers immediately.

—Vivek
From: Allyson Price <allyson.price@urbantech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@urbantech.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap ownership, timeline rebaseline, and delivery risk rundown

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the update and for calling out the marketplace billing work. UrbanTech is tracking the marketplace contract changes on our side but want to flag two items:

- We have an internal compliance window Jan 11–22 where we cannot accept any billing schema changes due to audit freezes. That makes your Jan 10 -> Feb 1 shift sensible from our perspective.
- Demo/delivery expectation: our product team prefers a short pre-demo with your eng reps the week before any public canary so we can prepare test data. Can Karthik's team own a 30–45 min run-through around Jan 12–14?

If you need procurement contacts or a sandbox tenant earlier, loop procurement@urbantech.com and we can provision.

Best,
Allyson Price
Senior PM, Integrations — UrbanTech
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Allyson Price <allyson.price@urbantech.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap ownership, timeline rebaseline, and delivery risk rundown

Allyson — appreciate the timing note, that helps.

Quick update following replies and a brief sync with leads:
- Karthik confirms ownership for Launch A and agrees to the demo/perf snapshot. He will schedule the 30–45 min pre-canary run-through with UrbanTech for Jan 13.
- Laura is pushing procurement and expects signoff by Dec 8; if that slips we will gate Launch B and use the Feb 1 target as the public date.
- Marcus will extend the soak to 72h and include additional sequence-length stress cases; new soak window target: Dec 16–19.
- I will open a JIRA ticket (INF-4921) to track the ownership commitments and will update the delivery-risk-matrix with the new soak plan and exec decision points.

Actions (owners / due):
- Karthik: schedule pre-canary with UrbanTech (due: Dec 10)
- Laura: confirm procurement signoff (due: Dec 8)
- Marcus: run 72h soak and report (due: Dec 20)
- Mina: update matrix and create INF-4921 (done)

If anything changes or you need to escalate, please mark the JIRA ticket and flag me. I will include this rebaseline in the QBR packet we circulate next week.

Thanks —
Mina
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: delivery-risk-matrix.xlsx (see sheet: rebaseline_v2), commitment-rebaseline.md
